directive.listen: Sets the address and port on which the server accepts requests. E.g. 80, 443 ssl, 127.0.0.1:8080
directive.server_name: Sets the domain names this server block responds to. Multiple names can be listed separated by spaces.
directive.server_tokens: Sets whether to expose the nginx version in error pages and the Server response header. off is recommended.
directive.absolute_redirect: Sets whether redirects issued by nginx use absolute URLs in the Location header.
directive.server_name_in_redirect: Sets whether to include the server_name in the Location header of redirects.
directive.port_in_redirect: Sets whether to include the port in the Location header of redirects.
directive.sendfile: Sets whether to use the kernel sendfile to speed up serving static files.
directive.sendfile_max_chunk: Sets the maximum amount of data that can be transferred in a single sendfile call.
directive.tcp_nopush: Used together with sendfile, collects response packets before sending to improve network efficiency.
directive.tcp_nodelay: Enables TCP_NODELAY on keepalive connections to reduce latency.
directive.keepalive_timeout: Sets the timeout for keeping keepalive connections with clients open. 0 disables keepalive.
directive.keepalive_requests: Sets the maximum number of requests that can be served through one keepalive connection.
directive.keepalive_time: Sets the maximum time a connection can be kept open between requests.
directive.reset_timedout_connection: Sets whether to send an RST packet before closing a timed-out connection.
directive.lingering_close: Sets how remaining data is consumed after closing a connection. off/on/always.
directive.lingering_time: Sets the maximum time to wait for additional data during lingering close.
directive.lingering_timeout: Sets the maximum time to wait for the next piece of data during lingering close.
directive.client_header_timeout: Sets the maximum time allowed for reading the client request header.
directive.client_body_timeout: Sets the maximum time allowed for reading the client request body.
directive.send_timeout: Sets the maximum wait time between successive sends to the client.
directive.root: Sets the document root directory that request URIs are mapped to.
directive.index: Sets the default file returned for requests to a directory.
directive.error_page: Sets the URI or response to return for specific error codes.
directive.try_files: Tries files/URIs in order for a request and performs an internal redirect to the last argument.
directive.default_type: Sets the default MIME type for responses with no file extension mapping.
directive.client_max_body_size: Sets the maximum size of the client request body. Returns 413 when exceeded.
directive.client_body_buffer_size: Sets the buffer size used when reading the request body.
directive.client_body_in_file_only: Sets whether the request body is always stored in a file. off/on/clean.
directive.client_body_in_single_buffer: Sets whether the entire request body is stored in a single buffer.
directive.client_header_buffer_size: Sets the default buffer size used when reading the request header.
directive.large_client_header_buffers: Sets the maximum number and size of buffers for large request headers.
directive.limit_rate: Limits the rate of response transmission to the client. E.g. 1m, 512k.
directive.limit_rate_after: Applies rate limiting only after this amount of data has been sent.
directive.limit_conn: Limits the number of simultaneous connections per key (e.g. $binary_remote_addr).
directive.limit_conn_dry_run: Only logs whether connections would exceed the limit without actually applying it.
directive.limit_conn_log_level: Sets the log level used when the connection limit is exceeded.
directive.limit_conn_status: Sets the status code returned when the connection limit is exceeded.
directive.limit_req: Limits the request processing rate per key. Uses the zone and burst options.
directive.limit_req_dry_run: Only logs whether requests would exceed the limit without actually applying it.
directive.limit_req_log_level: Sets the log level used when the request limit is exceeded.
directive.limit_req_status: Sets the status code returned when the request limit is exceeded.
directive.max_ranges: Sets the maximum number of ranges allowed in a Range request. 0 means no limit.
directive.add_header: Sets a custom header to add to responses. E.g. X-Frame-Options DENY.
directive.add_trailer: Sets trailer headers to add at the end of chunked responses.
directive.access_log: Sets the access log file path and format. Can be disabled with off.
directive.error_log: Sets the error log file path and level.
directive.log_not_found: Sets whether to log requests for nonexistent files (404).
directive.log_subrequest: Sets whether to log subrequests resulting from internal redirects.
directive.rewrite_log: Sets whether to log the rewrite processing to the error log.
directive.return: Returns a status code immediately and optionally a URL. E.g. 301 https://example.com.
directive.rewrite: Rewrites the URI using a regular expression. Supports the last/break/redirect/permanent flags.
directive.set: Assigns a value to a variable. E.g. set $upstream http://backend.
directive.break: Stops processing rewrite directives in the current context.
directive.uninitialized_variable_warn: Sets whether to log a warning when an uninitialized variable is used.
directive.proxy_pass: Sets the upstream URL to forward requests to. Path forwarding depends on whether a URI is included.
directive.proxy_http_version: Sets the HTTP version used when sending requests to upstream. 1.1 is recommended for keepalive.
directive.proxy_set_header: Sets request headers passed to upstream. E.g. Host $host.
directive.proxy_set_body: Overrides the request body passed to upstream.
directive.proxy_redirect: Rewrites the Location/Refresh response headers from upstream.
directive.proxy_hide_header: Sets headers to remove from the upstream response.
directive.proxy_pass_header: Sets whether headers hidden by default are passed through to the client.
directive.proxy_buffering: Sets whether upstream responses are buffered. off streams them immediately.
directive.proxy_buffers: Sets the number and size of buffers used when reading upstream responses.
directive.proxy_buffer_size: Sets the buffer size used for reading the first part (headers) of an upstream response.
directive.proxy_busy_buffers_size: Sets the maximum size of buffers being sent to the client.
directive.proxy_max_temp_file_size: Sets the maximum size of temporary files used when buffering responses.
directive.proxy_temp_path: Sets the directory where temporary files for upstream responses are stored.
directive.proxy_connect_timeout: Sets the maximum time allowed for establishing a connection to upstream.
directive.proxy_send_timeout: Sets the maximum wait time between successive sends to upstream.
directive.proxy_read_timeout: Sets the maximum wait time between successive reads from upstream.
directive.proxy_next_upstream: Sets on which errors/responses the request is retried with the next upstream.
directive.proxy_next_upstream_tries: Sets the maximum number of attempts to switch to the next upstream.
directive.proxy_next_upstream_timeout: Sets the maximum time allowed for switching to the next upstream.
directive.proxy_cache: Sets the shared memory zone used for caching responses.
directive.proxy_cache_key: Sets the string used to build the cache key. E.g. $scheme$host$request_uri.
directive.proxy_cache_valid: Sets the cache validity time per response status code. E.g. 200 1m.
directive.proxy_cache_bypass: Forwards to upstream without checking the cache when the condition is true.
directive.proxy_no_cache: Does not save the response to the cache when the condition is true.
directive.ssl_certificate: Sets the path to the certificate file in PEM format.
directive.ssl_certificate_key: Sets the path to the private key file corresponding to the certificate.
directive.ssl_password_file: Sets the path to the file containing the passphrase for the private key.
directive.ssl_protocols: Sets the allowed TLS protocol versions. E.g. TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3.
directive.ssl_ciphers: Sets the list of allowed cipher suites.
directive.ssl_prefer_server_ciphers: Sets whether to use the server cipher order instead of the client's.
directive.ssl_session_cache: Sets the SSL session cache. E.g. shared:SSL:10m.
directive.ssl_session_timeout: Sets the validity time of the SSL session cache.
directive.ssl_session_tickets: Sets whether to use TLS session ticket resumption.
directive.ssl_session_ticket_key: Sets the key file used to encrypt session tickets.
directive.ssl_buffer_size: Sets the buffer size used for SSL data transmission.
directive.ssl_verify_client: Sets whether to verify client certificates. off/on/optional/optional_no_ca.
directive.ssl_verify_depth: Sets the verification depth of the client certificate chain.
directive.ssl_client_certificate: Sets the CA certificate file used to verify client certificates.
directive.ssl_crl: Sets the certificate revocation list (CRL) file.
directive.ssl_trusted_certificate: Sets the CA chain file used for OCSP stapling verification.
directive.ssl_dhparam: Sets the DH parameters file used for DHE key exchange.
directive.ssl_ecdh_curve: Sets the curve used for ECDHE key exchange.
directive.ssl_reject_handshake: Sets whether to reject the TLS handshake immediately when no certificate is present.
directive.ssl_early_data: Sets whether to allow TLS 1.3 0-RTT early data.
directive.ssl_stapling: Sets whether to enable OCSP stapling.
directive.ssl_stapling_file: Sets the OCSP response file used for stapling.
directive.ssl_stapling_responder: Sets the responder URL used to look up OCSP responses.
directive.ssl_stapling_verify: Sets whether to verify the signature of OCSP responses.
directive.allow: Allows access from a specific address. Specify a CIDR or IP.
directive.deny: Denies access from a specific address. Specify a CIDR or IP.
directive.auth_basic: Enables HTTP Basic authentication and sets the realm name.
directive.auth_basic_user_file: Sets the path to the file with the Basic auth user list (htpasswd format).
directive.auth_request: Delegates the access decision to the result of a subrequest. E.g. /auth.
directive.auth_request_set: Sets a variable from the auth_request response.
directive.satisfy: Sets whether access is allowed when all or any of the access control conditions are met.
directive.set_real_ip_from: Restores the real client IP by specifying trusted proxy addresses.
directive.real_ip_header: Sets the header that contains the real client IP. E.g. X-Real-IP.
directive.real_ip_recursive: Sets whether to find the original client IP recursively along the proxy chain.
directive.gzip: Sets whether gzip compression of responses is enabled.
directive.gzip_types: Sets the MIME types to compress. E.g. text/plain application/json.
directive.gzip_min_length: Compresses only responses larger than this size.
directive.gzip_comp_level: Sets the compression level (1 to 9). Higher compresses more but uses more CPU.
directive.gzip_buffers: Sets the number and size of buffers used for compression.
directive.gzip_http_version: Sets the minimum HTTP version required for compressed responses.
directive.gzip_proxied: Sets for which proxy responses compression is applied.
directive.gzip_disable: Sets User-Agent patterns to exclude from compression.
directive.gzip_vary: Sets whether to add the Vary: Accept-Encoding header when compressing.
directive.gzip_static: Sets whether to serve precompressed .gz files.
directive.charset: Sets the charset added to responses. E.g. utf-8.
directive.charset_types: Sets the MIME types to which the charset is applied.
directive.source_charset: Sets the charset of source files and converts them to the response charset.
directive.override_charset: Sets whether to override the charset of received responses. off/on/charset.
directive.etag: Sets whether to generate the ETag header for static file responses.
directive.expires: Sets the Cache-Control/Expires headers for static responses. E.g. 30d.
directive.disable_symlinks: Sets whether access through symbolic links is allowed.
directive.directio: Reads files larger than this size using Direct I/O.
directive.directio_alignment: Sets the alignment size for Direct I/O.
directive.output_buffers: Sets the number and size of buffers used for transmitting the response body.
directive.postpone_output: Starts transmission after this much data has been accumulated.
directive.request_id: Sets whether to add the X-Request-ID header to responses.
directive.ignore_invalid_headers: Sets whether to ignore request headers with invalid names.
directive.merge_slashes: Sets whether to merge consecutive slashes in a URI.
directive.msie_padding: Sets whether to pad MSIE error pages to at least 512 bytes.
directive.msie_refresh: Sets whether MSIE error pages redirect using a Refresh header.
directive.open_file_cache: Sets the open file cache configuration. E.g. max=1000 inactive=20s.
directive.open_file_cache_errors: Sets whether to cache file lookup errors.
directive.open_file_cache_min_uses: Sets the minimum number of uses before a file is kept in the cache.
directive.open_file_cache_valid: Sets the validity time of cached file information.
directive.read_ahead: Sets the number of bytes read ahead when reading files.
directive.recursive_error_pages: Sets whether error_page processing is performed recursively.
directive.resolver: Sets the DNS servers used for dynamic name resolution.
directive.resolver_timeout: Sets the maximum time allowed for DNS resolution.
directive.random_index: Sets whether a random file is returned for directory requests.
directive.mirror: Sets the mirror URI to which a copy of the original request is sent.
directive.mirror_request_body: Sets whether the original request body is included in mirror requests.
directive.sub_filter: Replaces a string in the response body with another string.
directive.sub_filter_once: Sets whether replacement is performed only on the first match.
directive.sub_filter_types: Sets the MIME types to which sub_filter is applied.
directive.http2_chunk_size: Sets the maximum chunk size of the HTTP/2 response body.
directive.http2_max_concurrent_streams: Sets the upper limit of simultaneous HTTP/2 streams per connection.
directive.http2_push_preload: Sets whether preloads in Link headers are converted to HTTP/2 pushes.

upstreamOption.serverAddress: Sets the server address (IP or domain, with optional port) to include in the upstream.
upstreamOption.weight: Sets the load balancing weight. The default is 1.
upstreamOption.maxConns: Sets the upper limit of simultaneous connections to this server.
upstreamOption.maxFails: Sets the number of failed attempts allowed before this server is considered unavailable.
upstreamOption.failTimeout: Sets the time to wait before retrying this server after a failure.
upstreamOption.backup: Marks this server as a backup used only when all other servers are unavailable.
upstreamOption.down: Marks this server as temporarily down.
upstreamOption.resolve: Periodically re-resolves the server address with DNS when it changes.
